description: Instantiates real tasks from Asana Task Templates.

commands.name: create_tasks_from_template
commands.description: POST /task_templates/{gid}/instantiateTask for each given template_gid. Returns asynchronous jobs, not the final tasks directly -- the caller must poll /jobs/{job_gid} if they need to confirm creation.

template_gids.description: IDs of the Asana Task Templates to instantiate.

name.description: Optional: overrides the template's default name.
